in_marathi.name: Parmish
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parmish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit roots ‘par’ meaning supreme and ‘mishra’ meaning mixture, Parmish signifies the supreme lord or the one who is above all. In Hindu mythology, Parmish is a name given to various gods and goddesses, representing their supreme power and dominance.
